summary: Official warnings note that Baloxavir Marboxil can cause severe allergic reactions, which may involve swelling beneath the skin, hives, and serious skin rashes [3]. Warnings also indicate a higher occurrence of the virus becoming resistant to treatment in children under five years of age [3]. In addition, a small computer model, rather than tests on human beings, estimated a high score for liver risks and a low score for heart risks [M].
